title: Order the Lamp
story: A lamp class and its test run are shuffled. Put them in a working order.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program prints True.
hints: The class must be defined before you create a lamp from it.
Inside the class, __init__ comes before toggle. Use indentation to see which lines are inside.
socratic: What must exist before Light() runs?
Which lines belong inside each method?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
